title: Black Widow Limited
lines: OFFICIAL BALL OF THE 2015 MEN'S US OPEN
This limited production release was originally designed for the 2015 Men's US open Pro-Am. Supplies are very limited, make sure to get yours today!
Black Widow Limited takes our most successful core in the history of Hammer, the Gas Mask Core, and marries it with our brand new explosive Semtex Pearl cover.
The overall strength of the Black Widow Limited puts it just a notch above our highly successful Red Legend in total hook potential.
The 1000 Abralon TM polished finish gives the Black Widow Limited the perfect amount of skid in the oil for explosive down-lane motion.
Our legendary Gas Mask Core creates a strong overall ball motion that never quits.
Semtex is a brand new cover that has never before been featured. This cover is simply explosive on the lanes!
REACTION Strong Mid-Lane with Aggressive Backend
FACTORY FINISH 500 / 1000 Abralon® Polished w/Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Heavy Oil
